name: athenaeum-gallery
description: The NEW gallery frontend -- React + Vite, first-class. Not the Loom's delivery (no vendor globals, no Babel fallback, no single-file JSX): real component files, real modules, hot reload in dev (`npm run dev` proxies /api to the running Flask server), and a fixed-name production bundle in gallery/dist served by moonglade_gallery.py at the front door, /.
